Maya (PMM): Need a short battlecard for SDRs vs cloud endpoints and hosted LLM APIs. Keep it snackable for threads.
Jon (Growth): 3 quick hooks + 4 rebuttals, plus 2 micro-bench stats.
Priya (Sales): Make the ROI line tiny: 'typical cost improvements after tuning.'
Theo (Product): Callouts: same API across Hosted/Dedicated/Private; canary rollouts; KV prefix caching; optimized kernels.
Maya (PMM): Draft hooks:
- 'Same API, no rewrite as you scale infra.'
- 'Predictable latency SLOs and automated fallbacks.'
- 'Unit-cost controls via batching & cache.'
Jon (Growth): Rebuttals (short):
- 'Clouds sell capacity; we ship inference ops + routing.'
- 'Hosted APIs are easy, but lock you in; we enable mobility.'
- 'Runtime libs lack observability and rollout controls.'
Priya (Sales): Micro-bench notes: 'Customers often see p95 improvements after Dedicated + batching.'
AssetsBot: Reminder 1 webinar assets due in 3 business days. Link: https://cal.example/webinar/2291
Maya (PMM): Action: Jon writes SDR script, Theo provides 2-line blurbs, Priya defines lead tags (latency/cost/compliance).
